findings.title: Relocated folder's sync provider is detected only after the gate has committed
findings.body:
`relocateFolder` calls `relocateWorkspace` (index.ts:751), which for the active workspace runs `relocateActive` (relocate.ts:48, switch-transaction.ts:121-136). That transaction calls `gate.commit(id)` and `afterCommit` (switch-transaction.ts:136), and releases `inFlight`, before this handler reaches `syncStates.refresh(current)` at line 755.

In that window `syncStates.of()` still answers from the path rule (sync-state.ts:26-29), and the new path is not in `known`. A Google Drive folder outside `~/Library/CloudStorage` is recognised only by its xattr (synced-folder.ts:83-91), so the path rule returns null and the folder is treated as plain. A capture started in the window goes through `create()` (recording-writer.ts:136-139, 181): `stagingFor` returns `.kaipu/tmp`, and `byRename` is false, so finalize uses `placeNew`, which hard-links (recording-writer.ts:113). That is the hard-link-into-Drive case decision 15 rules out. The window lasts as long as the xattr detection (up to 2 s, synced-folder.ts:22, 86-90). The sibling paths avoid this: `addWorkspace` (index.ts:577-578) and `createWorkspace` (index.ts:628-630) refresh before `runSwitch`. The `afterCommit` broadcast (index.ts:528) also runs before the refresh, so the switcher's first listing carries the stale null until the broadcast at line 759.

Suggested fix: detect the new folder before `gate.commit`, the way `addWorkspace` and `createWorkspace` do before `runSwitch`. For example, wrap `registry.relocate` in the deps that `relocateFolder` passes to `relocateWorkspace` (index.ts:728), so the relocated entry is refreshed inside `apply` before `relocateActive` commits. Keep the post-commit refresh only if the pre-commit one is absent for the non-active path.

findings.title: No main-process test covers the relocate result or the new sync refresh
findings.body: The new `workspace` field on the `ok: true` result (line 762) and the new `syncStates.refresh` (line 755) are not exercised by any test. There is no `index.test.ts` under `main/workspaces/` (the test files there cover relocate.ts, registry and switch-transaction only). The field is also what the type requires: `WorkspaceRelocateResult` `ok: true` has `workspace: WorkspaceView` (shared/types/workspaces.ts:183-189). The renderer reads `result.workspace.name` in `onRelocated` (renderer/src/features/workspaces/workspaces-context.tsx:208-211). Before this diff the success result had no `workspace`, so this line fixes a real contract break, and nothing pins it. A test could assert that a successful relocate returns the relocated folder's `workspace.path`, `state` and `sync`. Adding it needs an electron mock, which this part does not have.

contracts.action: Change folder… (workspaces:relocate): the relocated workspace is re-detected for its sync provider, probed, and its workspace view is returned
contracts.before_after: addWorkspace and createWorkspace detect the folder before the switch (refresh at 578 and 630, before runSwitch). relocateFolder detects after relocateWorkspace has committed the gate (relocate.ts:48 → switch-transaction.ts:136 afterCommit and gate.commit). The new code then does availabilityOf and returns the view, which the siblings also do. Before this diff the ok result had no `workspace` field, although the type requires it (shared/types/workspaces.ts:183-189).
contracts.visible_effect: The renderer's changeFolder reads result.workspace.name for the 'folder changed' toast (workspaces-context.tsx:208-211). That is now defined. The switcher shows the provider after the final broadcastState at line 759; the afterCommit broadcast (index.ts:528) can show the stale path-rule answer until then.
contracts.failure_mode: Between gate commit and refresh, a capture started on an xattr-only Drive folder takes staging from the path rule (recording-writer.ts:139, 181) and places by link (recording-writer.ts:113). Silent hard link into the synced folder. The window is only as long as detection (up to 2 s). If refresh or availabilityOf throws, the IPC rejects after the folder was already changed, and the renderer shows relocateUncertain (workspaces-context.tsx:222-223). detectSync never throws (synced-folder.ts:74-91).
contracts.open_question: Confirm that a record start can reach RecordingWriter.create (through the record path and requireCaptureWorkspace) between the gate commit and the refresh at line 755. I read the lock release and the staging decision, but not the record hotkey path in main/recording/recording-hub.ts.

structuredOutput.summary: Part 1 (index.ts, +5 −0) adds a sync-state refresh, an availability probe and a `workspace` field to the relocate handler. The `workspace` field fixes a missing required field on the success result. But the refresh runs after the gate has committed, unlike the addWorkspace and createWorkspace siblings that refresh before the switch. That leaves a short window where a capture on an xattr-only Drive folder could be placed by hard link. Open threads don't touch this file, so there are no thread replies.
